paintTool.brushTip: Paints the faces you see under the circle
paintTool.sphereTip: Paints everything inside the ball, front and back
paintTool.smartFillTip: Fills connected faces that meet at less than the angle
paintTool.bucketTip: Fills the painted area you click, up to the angle
paintTool.heightRangeTip: Paints every part all round, from where you click up by the height
paintTool.overhangsOnlyTip: The brush and fills paint only the faces highlighted as overhangs
paintTool.brushHint: Drag on a part to paint. Drag off the parts to turn the view.
paintTool.heightHint: Tap a part where the band starts.
paintTool.remapTip: Moves the paint on {{where}} from one filament to another
